headline_marked: Brazil names squad for [[Joao Pedro and Estevao recalled]] for friendlies
headline: Brazil names squad for Joao Pedro and Estevao recalled for friendlies
summary: Coach Carlo Ancelotti begins rebuilding the national team with several new faces for upcoming matches against Australia and India.
details: Chelsea forwards Joao Pedro and Estevao have been recalled to Brazil's squad for September and October friendlies against Australia and India.
Coach Carlo Ancelotti is rebuilding the national team following a disappointing World Cup campaign where they were eliminated by Norway in the last 16.
Joao Pedro had been left out of the previous World Cup squad to make room for Neymar, while Estevao had been a key figure before suffering an injury.
The squad includes several new faces, such as goalkeepers Pedro Morisco and Otavio, defender Mauro Junior, and midfielders Breno Bidon and Gabriel Bontempo.
Established stars like Vinicius Junior, Raphinha, and Bruno Guimaraes also return to the national side.
Notable absentees include Neymar, who has announced his international retirement at age 34, and players like Casemiro and Alisson.
Brazil will play Australia in Townsville on September 25 and Brisbane on September 29, before facing India in Kolkata on October 3.
caption:
Brazil is rebuilding! Joao Pedro and Estevao return as Carlo Ancelotti names his squad for upcoming friendlies.

Chelsea forwards Joao Pedro and Estevao have been recalled to Brazil's squad for September and October friendlies against Australia and India.

Coach Carlo Ancelotti is rebuilding the national team following a disappointing World Cup campaign where they were eliminated by Norway in the last 16.

Joao Pedro had been left out of the previous World Cup squad to make room for Neymar, while Estevao had been a key figure before suffering an injury.

The squad includes several new faces, such as goalkeepers Pedro Morisco and Otavio, defender Mauro Junior, and midfielders Breno Bidon and Gabriel Bontempo.

Established stars like Vinicius Junior, Raphinha, and Bruno Guimaraes also return to the national side.

Notable absentees include Neymar, who has announced his international retirement at age 34, and players like Casemiro and Alisson.

Brazil will play Australia in Townsville on September 25 and Brisbane on September 29, before facing India in Kolkata on October 3.

headline_marked: Pabna: [[Couple killed in road accident]] 2 days before son’s wedding
headline: Pabna: Couple killed in road accident 2 days before son’s wedding
summary: A man and woman were killed after a speeding truck collided head-on with their motorcycle in Ishwardi, Pabna, while they were returning from wedding shopping.
details: A man and woman were killed after a speeding truck collided head-on with their motorcycle in Sahapur village of Pabna's Ishwardi upazila.
The victims have been identified as Anwar and Sapna, residents of Sahapur village, according to police.
The accident occurred around 8:00 pm at the Alhaj Mor area. A speeding truck coming from the opposite direction lost control and ran over the motorcycle.
The couple was returning home on their motorcycle after shopping for the wedding of their son, Shakil Ahmed Siam.
Sapna died at the scene, while Anwar was rushed to the Ishwardi Upazila Health Complex by police and firefighters, where he succumbed to his injuries around 8:30 pm.
Police have seized the truck, but the driver managed to flee the scene. The bodies were handed over to the family without an autopsy.
The tragedy comes just before the wedding festivities; the couple's son was scheduled to hold his Gaye Holud ceremony on Thursday and his wedding on Friday.
caption:
A couple was killed in a road accident just two days before their son's wedding.

A man and woman were killed after a speeding truck collided head-on with their motorcycle in Sahapur village of Pabna's Ishwardi upazila.

The victims have been identified as Anwar and Sapna, residents of Sahapur village, according to police.

The accident occurred around 8:00 pm at the Alhaj Mor area. A speeding truck coming from the opposite direction lost control and ran over the motorcycle.

The couple was returning home on their motorcycle after shopping for the wedding of their son, Shakil Ahmed Siam.

Sapna died at the scene, while Anwar was rushed to the Ishwardi Upazila Health Complex by police and firefighters, where he succumbed to his injuries around 8:30 pm.

Police have seized the truck, but the driver managed to flee the scene. The bodies were handed over to the family without an autopsy.

The tragedy comes just before the wedding festivities; the couple's son was scheduled to hold his Gaye Holud ceremony on Thursday and his wedding on Friday.
